rule: S_N must be unique across all records as it serves as a one-to-one join key
rationale: Column is designated as a one-to-one key with Cust_Bio_dirty.S_N but contains 1 duplicate value (3), breaking uniqueness constraints for a serial number identifier

rule: S_N must not be null
rationale: S_N is a mandatory join key and identifier with 0% missing values; nulls would break referential integrity

rule: Every S_N in Acc_Info_dirty must exist in Cust_Bio_dirty.S_N
rationale: S_N is defined as a one-to-one key with Cust_Bio_dirty.S_N; referential integrity must be enforced before joining

rule: Account_No must be exactly 4 digits
rationale: Account numbers are 4-digit identifiers (range 1001-1028) stored as integers but intended as strings; must conform to 4-digit pattern

rule: Account_No should be unique unless business rules explicitly permit duplicate accounts
rationale: Evidence shows 2 duplicate values (1001, 1010) appearing twice each; recommended actions suggest clarifying if duplicates are valid or require deduplication

rule: Account_No must not be null
rationale: Account identifier is mandatory with 0% missing values

rule: Full_Name must use title case (first letter of each word capitalized) except for lowercase particles (bin, binte, s/o, d/o)
rationale: Sample contains lowercase deviations: 'irfan', 'junrong', 'tan' (in 'Hui Min tan'), 'yixuan' (in 'Lee yixuan'); standardization recommended to dominant title-case convention

check_params.logic: any(w.strip()[0].islower() for w in str(row['Full_Name']).split() if w.strip().lower() not in ('bin','binte','s/o','d/o') and len(w.strip()) > 0)

rule: Full_Name must not be null
rationale: Full name is mandatory personal identifier with 0% missing values

rule: ID must match Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one letter (S, T, F, or G), followed by exactly 7 digits, ending with one uppercase letter
rationale: 96.7% of values follow format S/T/F/G + 7 digits + checksum (e.g., S8403757E), but one value 'S123456' is truncated to 6 digits without checksum

rule: ID must be unique
rationale: National ID numbers should be unique identifiers; all 30 sample values are distinct

rule: ID must not be null
rationale: ID is mandatory unique identifier with 0% missing values

rule: JoinDate must be a parseable date in YYYY-MM-DD format
rationale: Column stored as string but intended as datetime; contains unparseable value '2025-13-01' (invalid month 13)

rule: JoinDate must not be in the future
rationale: JoinDate is a historical field (account creation); sample contains future date '2027-01-15' which exceeds current date

rule: JoinDate must not be null
rationale: Join date is mandatory temporal field with 3.3% missing values (1 null); recommended actions suggest confirming if missing represents data collection gaps

rule: LastLogin must be a parseable datetime in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format
rationale: Column stored as string but intended as datetime64[ns]; all sample values follow consistent 19-character timestamp format

rule: LastLogin must not be null
rationale: Last login timestamp is mandatory activity marker with 0% missing values

rule: JoinDate must be on or before LastLogin (account creation must precede last activity)
rationale: Sample record S_N 20 shows LastLogin '2019-01-01' before JoinDate '2020-11-02', which is logically impossible

rule: Subscription_Type must be one of: Basic, Free, Gold, Platinum, Premium
rationale: Categorical field with 5 observed valid values; no anomalies detected in sample

rule: Subscription_Type must not be null
rationale: Subscription tier is mandatory categorical field with 0% missing values

rule: SubscriptionFee must be parseable as a numeric value
rationale: Column stored as string but intended as float64; contains text value 'free' which cannot be parsed as number

rule: SubscriptionFee must not be sentinel value 99999
rationale: Value '99999' appears as statistical outlier exceeding upper fence (1640.65) and likely represents missing/invalid data sentinel

rule: SubscriptionFee must be non-negative (>= 0)
rationale: Subscription fees represent monetary charges which should not be negative; negative values would indicate data errors

rule: SubscriptionFee must not be null
rationale: Field has 6.7% missing values (2 nulls); recommended actions suggest confirming if missing values are expected or if field should be mandatory

rule: If Subscription_Type is 'Free', SubscriptionFee must be 0 or null
rationale: Business logic: Free subscriptions should not incur charges; sample shows violations (S_N 9: Free with 917.46, S_N 24: Free with 99999)

check_params.logic: row['Subscription_Type'] == 'Free' and pd.notna(row['SubscriptionFee']) and pd.to_numeric(row['SubscriptionFee'], errors='coerce') != 0
